notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited after saving, but not before the initial save.
REF-BM-07: List items show title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is unsupported.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions are implemented.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action is implemented.
REF-BM-22: The list has a fixed newest-first order and no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is escaped and not rendered.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
